lines.text: Every year in Wales, people race horses... on foot.

parts.tts: Every year in Wales, people race horses...
parts.heard: Every year in Wales, people race horses.

lines.text: It started in 1980, with an argument in a Welsh pub.

parts.tts: It started in nineteen eighty, with an argument in a Welsh pub.
parts.heard: It started in 1980, with an argument in a Welsh pub.

lines.text: Over a long distance, could a human keep up with a horse?

parts.tts: Over a long distance, could a human keep up with a horse?
parts.heard: Over a long distance, could a human keep up with a horse?

lines.text: The landlord overheard... and set up a race to find out.

parts.tts: and set up a race to find out.
parts.heard: and set up a race to find out.

lines.text: 22 miles over the Welsh hills: runners versus horses and riders.

parts.tts: twenty-two miles over the Welsh hills: runners versus horses and riders.
parts.heard: 22 miles over the Welsh hills, runners versus horses and riders.

lines.text: For 25 years, the horses won. Every. Single. Time.

parts.tts: For twenty-five years, the horses won. Every. Single. Time.
parts.heard: For 25 years, the horses won every single time.

lines.text: But here's the part... in 2004, a runner named Huw Lobb beat them all.

parts.tts: in two thousand four, a runner named Huw Lobb beat them all.
parts.heard: In 2004, a runner named Hugh Lobb beat them all.

lines.text: By about 2 minutes. And he took home a 25,000 pound prize.

parts.tts: By about two minutes. And he took home a twenty-five thousand pound prize.
parts.heard: by about two minutes, and he took home a 25,000 pound prize.

lines.text: Since then, humans have won just 4 more times, most recently in 2025.

parts.tts: Since then, humans have won just four more times, most recently in twenty twenty-five.
parts.heard: Since then, humans have won just four more times, most recently in 2025.

lines.text: Humans: 5 wins. Horses: pretty much all the rest.

parts.tts: Humans: five wins. Horses: pretty much all the rest.
parts.heard: humans, five wins, horses, pretty much all the rest.
